description: Save an email without sending it, to continue or review later. Can prepare a reply, reply-all or forward from an existing message.

attachments.description: Files with padded base64 content. An empty array removes all files.

content.description: Padded base64 file content, not a URL.

name.description: Optional display name, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes after trimming, without control characters.
Optional display name, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes after trimming, without control characters.

html.description: HTML alternative; null clears it. Editing text leaves saved HTML unchanged, so update or clear it too.

idempotency_key.description: Makes a retry safe: repeating the call with the same key and identical arguments within 24 hours of the first request returns the draft already created. Use a new key for each intended draft.

in_reply_to.description: Cherami ID of the received or accepted sent message in this inbox being replied to; null clears it. Set recipients and subject yourself, or use source on creation to derive them.

labels.description: Labels the sent copy gets when the draft is sent.

items.description: Case-sensitive label, trimmed; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

source.description: Prepare from a ready received or accepted sent message in this inbox. Recipients, subject and forwarded content are saved now and not regenerated when sending. Reply and reply-all recipients come from sender-written headers: check them against the assignment.

include_attachments.description: For forwards only; defaults to true, including embedded images.

text.description: Plain-text body; may be empty while drafting. For a forward prepared from source, this is the note placed before the original.

name.description: Optional display name, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes after trimming, without control characters.

created_at.description: Absolute ISO 8601 service timestamp in UTC (Z), with millisecond precision.

idempotency_expires_at.description: Absolute ISO 8601 service timestamp in UTC (Z), with millisecond precision.

updated_at.description: Absolute ISO 8601 service timestamp in UTC (Z), with millisecond precision.
